name: Tarak v1.0.1 — Multi-Node Clustering & Public Go SDK
highlights: Added multi-node clustering: separate Control Plane (tarakd) and Worker Node (taraks) daemons
Released public Go client SDK (pkg/client) and runtime primitives (pkg/tcr)
Published complete documentation portal with live changelog at tarak.vikshro.in
Fixed 1:1 brand icon synchronization and automated cross-platform build matrix
Native OCI layer extraction and zero-WSL container isolation on Windows, Linux, and macOS

name: Tarak v1.0.0 — Initial Production Release
highlights: Kubernetes API compliance with standard Core v1 and Apps v1 resources
Sub-25 MB idle RAM footprint and sub-180ms instant cold-start time
Integrated Virtual Pod Bridge networking with ClusterIP and MetalLB support
Mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication with built-in P-256 ECDSA Certificate Authority
